clue.text: Poor little lamb!

definitions.meaning: an Australian slang phrase for something of little worth or quality
read literally, a small cut of lamb served on the bone

explanation.walkthrough: The second reading takes the phrase at face value: a meagre piece of lamb is only a small cutlet. The first is Australian and New Zealand slang meaning 'no good'.
explanation.definitionFit: The slang phrase means worthless or inferior, and literally names a skimpy lamb cutlet.

clue.text: How fantastic to be out and about

parts.note: taken as written
re is a short Latin word meaning about or concerning

explanation.surface: Someone wondering how wonderful it is to be out and about.
explanation.definitionFit: Outlandish or bizarre behaviour can be called fantastic in the sense of strange.

clue.text: The least skimpy skirt is given to Mother

parts.note: a mini is a very short skirt
mum is an informal word for a mother

explanation.surface: A mother being handed the briefest of short skirts.
explanation.definitionFit: The smallest possible amount is the least there can be.

clue.text: Young lad in the motor trade needs a lot of bottle

parts.note: a car is a motor in British usage
a boy is a young lad

explanation.surface: A youngster working in the car business needs plenty of nerve.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Bottle' looks like British slang for courage, but here it is a real glass vessel; a carboy is a big one, often in a protective crate.
explanation.definitionFit: A carboy is a large container for liquids, so it holds a great deal as a vessel.

clue.text: To applaud gin makes nonsense

parts.note: to clap is to applaud
a gin is a snare or trap for catching animals

explanation.surface: Clapping for a glass of spirits is pure foolishness.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Gin' is not the drink but an old word for a snare.
explanation.definitionFit: Pretentious empty talk is rubbish, the same as nonsense.

clue.text: A Roman's involved in a row

indicators.note: involved suggests the letters are tangled up together and reworked

parts.note: the word Roman with its s kept as a letter

explanation.surface: A Roman citizen getting caught up in an argument.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Row' reads as a quarrel, pronounced to rhyme with 'cow'; the definition takes it as the act of rowing a boat, so someone in a row is a rower.
explanation.definitionFit: A rower in a boat is one taking part in the activity of rowing.

clue.text: He sees to it that a man's got aid or is rehabilitated

indicators.note: rehabilitated means restored and remade, so the letters are rebuilt in a new order

explanation.surface: A helper ensures a man gets assistance, or else he is put back on his feet.
explanation.definitionFit: The Biblical parable's helpful traveller has become the name for anyone who aids a stranger in need.

clue.text: Make more bowlers take up position there

definitions.meaning: to enlarge or add to something
in cricket a bowler delivers the ball from the marked line at the wicket, so they stand inside it

explanation.walkthrough: In cricket, the crease is the line marked at each wicket; split as IN CREASE the answer names where the bowler stands.
explanation.definitionFit: To augment is to make more; the split phrase names a bowler's position at the marked line.

clue.text: How Cassius looked when he was faring badly?

definitions.text: How Cassius looked when he was faring badly?

parts.words: How Cassius looked when he was faring badly?
parts.note: Shakespeare's Julius Caesar describes Cassius's look as thin and starving; faring badly is read as eating poorly

explanation.walkthrough: In Julius Caesar, Caesar says 'Yond Cassius has a lean and hungry look'. 'Faring' is read as eating, from fare meaning food.
explanation.definitionFit: Shakespeare's line describes Cassius as gaunt and starved-looking, which is how someone underfed appears.

clue.text: Not infrequently decimal

explanation.walkthrough: Split as OF TEN, the answer describes a decimal system, counted in tens.
explanation.definitionFit: Frequently means many times; decimal numbering is based on tens.

clue.text: Put in another order to get back the cooker

parts.note: the rear is the back
a range is a large kitchen stove

explanation.surface: Someone told to sort things differently to reach the stove at the back.
explanation.definitionFit: To reorder items is to place them in a different sequence.

clue.text: What the aspiring yacht-owner may do? Wow!

definitions.text: What the aspiring yacht-owner may do?
definitions.meaning: split as two words, someone longing for a yacht fantasises about a vessel
an exclamation at a gorgeous person, the sort of attractive heartthrob who prompts it

explanation.walkthrough: Split DREAM BOAT, it is what a would-be yacht owner does; whole, it is a very attractive person who might make someone say 'Wow!'.
explanation.definitionFit: A strikingly handsome person draws gasps of admiration; a yacht hopeful fantasises about owning a vessel.

clue.text: Medical man takes Ronald for a fool

parts.note: MO is a medical officer, an army doctor
Ron is short for Ronald

explanation.surface: A doctor considers a man named Ronald an idiot.
explanation.definitionFit: An idiot or dimwit is a fool.

clue.text: Did they alert Capone to take weapons?

parts.note: Al Capone was the Chicago gangster
arms are weapons

explanation.surface: A question whether warnings reached the gangster Al Capone about guns.
explanation.definitionFit: Warning bells and sirens are devices that alert people to danger.

clue.text: Order Ned a beer in Scotland

indicators.note: order is read as arrange, so these letters are put into a new arrangement

explanation.surface: Buying Ned a pint while north of the border.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Order' looks like asking the barman, but it signals rearranging NEDABEER. The definition is loose: the answer is a city in Scotland.
explanation.definitionFit: The granite city on the north-east coast is a Scottish port, found in Scotland.

clue.text: A man in it reorganised support

indicators.note: reorganised means put into a different arrangement, so these letters are reordered

explanation.surface: Reshuffling staff with a man placed inside the firm.
explanation.definitionFit: To keep something up or uphold it is to support it.

clue.text: The type to give an impudent look

definitions.meaning: printing type with thick heavy strokes

explanation.walkthrough: One sense is the printing term for heavy type; the other is a brazen face or expression.
explanation.definitionFit: Heavy printed letters are one typeface; a brazen expression is a cheeky look.

clue.text: A biblical translation prove-king strong hostility

parts.note: a version is a translation, such as the Authorised Version of the Bible

explanation.surface: A new rendering of scripture that stirs up fierce opposition.
explanation.walkthrough: 'prove-king' is the scan's split of 'provoking', a link word here.
explanation.definitionFit: Intense dislike or antipathy amounts to strong hostility.

clue.text: Where rail passengers may be left standing

definitions.text: Where rail passengers may be left standing

parts.words: Where rail passengers may be left standing
parts.note: a place trains stop on a railway, and also an old sense of standing or position

explanation.walkthrough: Passengers wait on the platform when a train leaves without them; the word also means a standing position or rank.
explanation.definitionFit: A railway stop is where travellers wait, and it also means a post or position.

clue.text: Part of the rifle set right into the wood

indicators.note: into signals one piece placed inside another

parts.note: beech is a kind of tree and its timber

explanation.surface: A gunsmith fitting a section of the gun into a wooden stock.
explanation.definitionFit: The rear section of a gun barrel where the cartridge is loaded is a component of the weapon.

clue.text: It earns exchange currency for the Greek wine-trade

definitions.text: It earns exchange currency for the Greek wine-trade

indicators.note: exchange means swap around, so these letters change places

explanation.surface: A product brings in foreign money for Greece's vintners.
explanation.walkthrough: 'exchange' looks like foreign exchange alongside 'currency', but it signals swapping ITEARNS around; the whole clue says this wine brings currency to Greece.
explanation.definitionFit: The resin-flavoured white wine of Greece is a major export earner for its vintners.

clue.text: Do take a drink, even if it causes trouble

parts.note: to act is to do
to sup is to take a drink

explanation.surface: Encouragement to have a drink even if it leads to bother.
explanation.definitionFit: To misbehave or play up is to cause trouble.

clue.text: Country in which the main dialects are Hindi

indicators.note: in which points to letters lying inside the words that follow

explanation.surface: A nation whose principal tongues include Hindi.
explanation.definitionFit: The South Asian republic is a nation, a country.

clue.text: Last month half Athens and London viewed a rigorous athletic contest

parts.note: Dec is the abbreviation for December, the year's last month

indicators.note: half takes the front half of each of the two city names

explanation.surface: Last December, people in Athens and London watched a demanding sports event.
explanation.definitionFit: A ten-event track and field competition is a punishing athletic contest.

clue.text: Large number ensnared by enticement to make money

indicators.note: ensnared by means caught inside, so one piece sits within the other

parts.note: a lure is an enticement
C is the Roman numeral for a hundred

explanation.surface: A huge figure lured in to make a fortune.
explanation.definitionFit: Filthy lucre is a disparaging term for cash, so it means money.

clue.text: The people dealing in cameras

indicators.note: dealing suggests cards being dealt out, so these letters are shuffled

explanation.surface: Shopkeepers who trade in photographic equipment.
explanation.walkthrough: 'dealing in' reads as trading, but 'dealing' signals rearranging INCAMERAS.
explanation.definitionFit: US citizens are a nation's people.

clue.text: Become liable to giving the mongrel a brusque command to enter

parts.note: In! is a curt order to come inside
a cur is a mongrel dog

explanation.surface: Someone who risks trouble by snapping at a mutt to get indoors.
explanation.definitionFit: To bring a cost or penalty upon oneself is to become liable to it.

clue.text: Where Atlantic fishermen may be experiencing difficulties

definitions.meaning: far out on the ocean over a great depth of sea

explanation.walkthrough: Literally, ocean fishermen are out over deep sea; idiomatically, the phrase means in serious trouble.
explanation.definitionFit: The idiom means in trouble; literally, far out at sea above great depths.
